title: AI-Powered Medical Prescription OCR & NLP System
excerpt: A prototype AI system that digitizes handwritten doctor prescriptions using multi-engine OCR, medical NLP, and a 253K+ Indian medicine database. Demo product with synthetic data for proof-of-concept purposes.
challenge: Handwritten prescriptions are illegible, causing medication errors and delays in pharmacy workflows
solution: Multi-engine OCR ensemble with Google, Azure & AWS, combined with medical-aware NLP and drug database enrichment
results: 98-99% medicine name extraction, 3-5 second processing, comprehensive drug database matching
contentHtml:
⚠️ IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER

This is a prototype/demo product developed for demonstration and proof-of-concept purposes only. All data shown, including patient information, prescriptions, and medications, is synthetic demo data and does not represent real patient records. This system is NOT intended for production medical use without proper regulatory compliance, security audits, and clinical validation.

🚀 Try the Live Demo

Experience the prescription OCR system yourself. Upload a handwritten prescription image and watch the AI extract patient info, medications, dosages, and more.

Executive Summary

The Medical Prescription OCR & NLP System demonstrates how artificial intelligence can digitize handwritten doctor prescriptions. By combining multiple cloud-based OCR engines, advanced NLP processing, and a comprehensive Indian medicine database, the system achieves high accuracy in extracting and structuring prescription data.

The Problem We Solved

Healthcare facilities, particularly in India, face significant challenges with handwritten prescriptions:

  • Illegibility: Handwritten prescriptions are often difficult to read, leading to medication errors
  • Manual Entry: Pharmacy staff spend significant time deciphering and manually entering prescription data
  • Data Loss: Valuable prescription data is lost in paper-based systems
  • Compliance: Difficulty in tracking and auditing prescription history
  • Integration: Manual prescriptions don't integrate with digital health records

System Architecture

The system follows a sophisticated multi-stage pipeline that processes prescription images through OCR, NLP, and knowledge enrichment:

How We Built It

Phase 1: Foundation (Week 1-2)

  • Project Setup: Initialized FastAPI backend with async support
  • Frontend: Set up React + TypeScript with Vite
  • Database: Configured PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy ORM
  • Infrastructure: Created image upload and storage pipeline

Phase 2: OCR Integration (Week 3-4)

  • Multi-Engine OCR: Integrated Google Document AI, Azure Form Recognizer, and AWS Textract
  • Section-Based Processing: Developed content-aware image segmentation
  • Ensemble Selection: Built confidence-based engine selection per section

Phase 3: NLP Pipeline (Week 5-6)

  • Medical Entity Extraction: Integrated AWS Comprehend Medical
  • AI Correction: Implemented Gemini AI for OCR error correction
  • Abbreviation Expansion: BD → Twice daily, TDS → Three times daily

Phase 4: Knowledge Integration (Week 7-8)

  • Drug Database: Loaded 253,973+ Indian medicine records
  • Fuzzy Matching: Implemented for medicine name lookup
  • RxNorm Integration: Added standardized drug codes

Phase 5: Frontend & Polish (Week 9-10)

  • Drag-and-Drop Upload: Intuitive prescription image upload
  • Real-time Feedback: Processing status indicators
  • Editable Results: Pharmacist review and correction interface

Key Features

1. Multi-Engine OCR Ensemble

Each prescription section is processed by ALL 3 OCR engines simultaneously. The system selects the best result per section based on confidence scores:

# Each section processed by ALL 3 OCR engines
google_result, azure_result, aws_result = await asyncio.gather(
    google_task, azure_task, aws_task
)

# Best engine selected based on confidence
best_result = select_best_ocr_by_confidence(
    google_result, azure_result, aws_result
)

2. Medical-Aware NLP

AWS Comprehend Medical extracts structured medical entities:

  • MEDICATION - Drug names
  • DOSAGE - Amounts (500mg, 1 tab)
  • FREQUENCY - Timing (BD, TDS, daily)
  • DURATION - Length (5 days, 2 weeks)
  • ROUTE_OR_MODE - Administration (oral, IV)

Gemini AI then corrects OCR errors using medical context:

  • "Prctmol" → "Paracetamol"
  • "BD" → "Twice daily"
  • "1/2 tab" → "Half tablet"

3. Knowledge Base Enrichment

Every extracted medication is enriched with:

  • RxNorm codes for standardization
  • Indian DB match for brand/generic mapping
  • Price information from 253K+ medicine records
  • Manufacturer details

4. Confidence-Based Routing

if confidence_score >= 0.95:
    action = "auto_approve"
elif confidence_score >= 0.85:
    action = "review_low_priority"
elif confidence_score >= 0.70:
    action = "review_high_priority"
else:
    action = "review_urgent"

Processing Pipeline

StepComponentTimeDescription
1Image Preprocessing~150msGrayscale, deskew, CLAHE enhancement, denoise
2Segmentation~90msDetect text regions, gap-based section splitting
3Parallel OCR~3000msRun Google, Azure, AWS on each section
4OCR Selection~10msSelect best engine per section by confidence
5Section Assembly~5msMerge sections, remove duplicates
6Medical NLP~4500msAWS Comprehend + Gemini correction
7Knowledge Enrichment~500msRxNorm + Indian DB lookup
Total~8.5sComplete prescription processing

Technology Stack

Backend

  • Python 3.11+ - Core language
  • FastAPI - High-performance async web framework
  • SQLAlchemy 2.0 - Async ORM
  • OpenCV - Image preprocessing
  • Google Document AI - Primary OCR engine
  • Azure Document Intelligence - Form recognition
  • AWS Textract - Layout analysis
  • AWS Comprehend Medical - Medical entity extraction
  • Google Gemini AI - Error correction & structuring
  • PostgreSQL - Database

Frontend

  • React 18 - UI framework
  • TypeScript - Type safety
  • Vite - Build tooling
  • TanStack Router - Client-side routing
  • Tailwind CSS - Styling
  • Axios - HTTP client

Limitations & Considerations

⚠️ Demo Limitations

  • No Authentication: Demo does not include user authentication
  • Demo Data Only: All patient and prescription data is synthetic
  • Cloud Dependencies: Requires internet for OCR/NLP services
  • Cost Considerations: Cloud API calls incur costs
  • No Regulatory Compliance: Not validated for HIPAA, GDPR, or clinical use

Production Considerations

Before deploying to production, address:

  • Security audit and penetration testing
  • Clinical validation with real pharmacists
  • HIPAA/local healthcare regulatory compliance
  • Robust error handling for edge cases
  • Application monitoring and logging
  • Database backup and disaster recovery
  • Rate limiting and abuse prevention

Future Roadmap

  • JWT authentication and role-based access control
  • Drug interaction warnings
  • Multi-language support (Hindi OCR)
  • EHR/EMR integration
  • Mobile application
  • Custom-trained OCR for medical handwriting

title: Secure Banking App for Regional Credit Union
excerpt: Built a secure, compliant mobile banking application serving 50,000+ members with real-time transactions and biometric authentication.
challenge: Modernize legacy banking system with mobile-first approach while maintaining strict security compliance
solution: Developed cross-platform mobile app with end-to-end encryption, biometric authentication, and real-time transaction processing
results: Increase in mobile transactions, high uptime, strong security posture
contentHtml:
When a regional credit union approached us to modernize their banking experience, they had a legacy system that was difficult to maintain and didn't meet modern user expectations. Their members needed a secure, intuitive mobile banking solution comparable to the best-in-class apps.

The Challenge

Key challenges included:

  • Legacy Integration: Integrate with existing core banking systems without disruption
  • Security & Compliance: Meet PCI DSS and banking security requirements
  • Accessible UX: Design for a wide range of ages and abilities
  • Real-time Updates: Provide instant balances and transaction confirmations

Our Solution

We built a cross-platform mobile app using React Native with a security-first architecture:

  • Biometric Authentication: Native Face/Touch ID for secure login
  • Encrypted Transport: TLS 1.2+ for all traffic and data minimization
  • Proactive Alerts: Real-time transaction and security notifications
  • Defense in Depth: MFA, device attestation, and fraud monitoring

Technical Implementation

The backend used Node.js and PostgreSQL with a microservices approach:

  • Event-driven services for scale and resilience
  • Redis caching for session and rate limits
  • AWS managed services for observability and security
  • PCI-compliant payment gateway integration for card operations

Impact

The credit union saw higher mobile engagement, strong reliability, and positive user feedback while maintaining strict security.

title: High-Traffic E-commerce Platform Migration
excerpt: Migrated legacy e-commerce system to modern cloud architecture, ready for peak-season traffic spikes.
challenge: Legacy system struggled during peak events, causing slow pages and instability
solution: Cloud-native migration with microservices, auto-scaling, and modern frontend
results: Improved conversion rates, lower page load times, stable peak performance
contentHtml:
A leading fashion retailer faced outages and slow pages during sales events. We modernized the stack to improve resilience and performance.

The Problem

  • Traffic Spikes: Unpredictable bursts overwhelmed the monolith
  • Performance: Long TTFB and blocking rendering
  • Data Layer: Single-node database created a bottleneck

Our Approach

  • Microservices: Independent services with clear contracts
  • Cloud-Native: Auto-scaling and managed services
  • Modern Frontend: Next.js with SSR/ISR for fast pages
  • Caching: Redis and CDN for low latency

Impact

The platform now sustains peak traffic with faster pages and improved conversion.

title: Telemedicine Platform for Rural Healthcare
excerpt: HIPAA-aligned telemedicine platform connecting rural patients with specialists.
challenge: Limited specialist access and long travel times for rural patients
solution: Secure video consults, integrated scheduling, and provider-to-provider data sharing
results: Reduced travel, faster access to care, high patient satisfaction
contentHtml:
Rural patients often travel hours for specialist care. We built a telemedicine platform to bridge that gap securely.

Challenges

  • Access: Long travel and limited local specialists
  • Privacy: Protected health information requirements
  • Device Diversity: Varying connectivity and devices

Solution

  • Secure Video: WebRTC with encrypted transport
  • Scheduling: Integrated calendars and reminders
  • Records: Provider-to-provider data exchange

Impact

Patients access specialists sooner with less travel; providers coordinate care more efficiently.

Operational metrics improved across cost, speed, and on-time delivery.
